note: Where naming went wrong before, and why. Seeded by the lead; the thinker and the review queue add entries.

entries.text: -SAVE, -WORK, -REGS, -AREA and -TEMP groups are scratch storage for an algorithm, not business entities. Do not give them domain names; they usually become locals or private state of the kernel that owns them.

evidence.summary: save, regs and work areas of the decimal library

entries.text: Avoid empty suffixes (Data, Info, Manager, Handler, Processor, Util) unless the COBOL evidence names that role. Prefer the business noun the comments use.

When neither comments nor data names nor sample records support a business meaning, say so: propose a structural name (e.g. InterestStep) with confidence below 0.5, so it goes to review. A confident wrong name is worse than a plain one.
